name: MAXIS
recent: Maxis 公布 2026 财年第三季度业绩，营收与净利均同比增长，并宣布第三次中期股息每股 4.5 仙。同期，公司拟以最高 8300 万令吉向 Astro 旗下 MBNS 收购宽频业务资产，属关联方交易。此外，EPF 在 8 月至 11 月间多次申报持股变动。
notable: 宣布第三次中期股息每股 4.5 仙，除息日 2026 年 11 月 27 日，派发日 2026 年 12 月 22 日。
拟以最高 8300 万令吉现金向 MBNS（Astro 全资子公司）收购宽频业务资产，属关联方交易。
公布 2026 财年第三季度业绩，营收同比增长 3.7%，净利同比增长 8.5%。
risks: 董事 Faizul bin Abdullah 于 2026 年 8 月 26 日出售 28,000 股普通股。
EPF 在 2026 年 8 月至 11 月间多次申报持股变动。
earnings: 2026 财年第三季度营收为 26.71 亿令吉，环比增长 1.1%，同比增长 3.7%；净利为 4.47 亿令吉，环比增长 2.5%，同比增长 8.5%；净利率为 16.7%，高于上一季度的 16.5%。

recent_en: Maxis reported Q3 FY2026 results with revenue and net profit rising year-on-year, and declared a third interim dividend of 4.5 sen per share. Meanwhile, it proposed to acquire broadband business assets from Astro's subsidiary MBNS for up to RM83 million, a related party transaction. EPF also filed multiple changes in shareholding between August and November.
notable_en: Declared a third interim dividend of 4.5 sen per share, with ex-date on 27 Nov 2026 and payment date on 22 Dec 2026.
Proposed to acquire broadband business assets from MBNS (a wholly-owned subsidiary of Astro) for up to RM83 million cash, a related party transaction.
Announced Q3 FY2026 results with revenue up 3.7% year-on-year and net profit up 8.5% year-on-year.
risks_en: Director Faizul bin Abdullah disposed of 28,000 ordinary shares on 26 Aug 2026.
EPF filed multiple changes in shareholding between August and November 2026.
earnings_en: Q3 FY2026 revenue was RM2.671 billion, up 1.1% QoQ and 3.7% YoY; net profit was RM447 million, up 2.5% QoQ and 8.5% YoY; net margin was 16.7%, up from 16.5% in the previous quarter.
